name: security_bypass_attempt
description: Notify user of a security bypass attempt detected on their account.

fields.name: total_attempts
fields.description: Cumulative bypass count for the user

name: interview_room_guide_client
description: Notify the client that an interview room has been created.

name: interview_room_guide_freelancer
description: Notify the freelancer that they have been invited to an interview room.

name: interview_room_message
description: Notify the receiver of a new interview room message or command notification. Builder returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the DM description without room headers, used for transcript logging.

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Title of the job linked to this room

fields.name: sender_role
fields.description: Either 'client' or 'freelancer' (optional; only for regular messages)

fields.name: sender_name
fields.description: Profile display name of the sender (optional; only for regular messages)

fields.name: msg_text
fields.description: The message content (optional; only for regular messages)

fields.name: command_name
fields.description: Command that was run (e.g. interview_budget); present = command notification mode

fields.name: executor_name
fields.description: Display name of the person who ran the command (optional)

fields.name: msg_data
fields.description: Execution details text (optional; for command notifications)

name: interview_room_transcript
description: Fire-and-forget notification that the interview transcript has been generated. Constant text only — no receiver names, IDs, or room references in the body. The builder adds the Room / Job header when available; the Room header is skipped when room_id is not obtainable.

fields.name: room_id
fields.description: The interview room ID (adds the Room header; optional when not obtainable)

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Title of the job (adds the Job header)

name: interview_room_signed_agreement
description: Fire-and-forget notification that the interview agreement has been signed. Constant text only — no receiver names, IDs, or room references in the body. The builder adds the Room / Job header when available; the Room header is skipped when room_id is not obtainable.

fields.name: room_id
fields.description: The interview room ID (adds the Room header; optional when not obtainable)

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Title of the job (adds the Job header)

name: interview_room_review_agreement
description: Fire-and-forget notification that the interview agreement is ready for review. Constant text only — no receiver names, IDs, or room references in the body. The builder adds the Room / Job header when available; the Room header is skipped when room_id is not obtainable.

fields.name: room_id
fields.description: The interview room ID (adds the Room header; optional when not obtainable)

fields.name: job_title
fields.description: Title of the job (adds the Job header)

name: interview_room_rules
description: Send interview room rules to both parties. Builder returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the rules body without room headers, used for transcript logging.

name: interview_room_job_details
description: Send job details to both parties in the interview room. Builder returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the details body without room headers, used for transcript logging.

name: premium_expiry_reminder
description: Notify the user that their premium benefits are about to end (generic, no interval specificity).

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Profile display name (Freelancer/Client username) for the greeting

name: interview_room_closure
description: Notify both parties when an interview room is concluded (agreement signed, party left, or system-closed). Builder reads everything from the closure record returned by /rooms/bot/closure-details/. Returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the closure body without room headers, used for transcript logging.

name: room_job_cancelled
description: Notify the freelancer when a client cancels a job that had an active agreement. Builder returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the notification body without room headers, used for transcript logging.

fields.name: client_name
fields.description: Display name of the client who cancelled

name: room_application_withdrawn
description: Notify the client when a freelancer withdraws an application that was accepted. Builder returns (embed, body_text) tuple — body_text is the notification body without room headers, used for transcript logging.

fields.name: freelancer_name
fields.description: Display name of the freelancer who withdrew
